about: The mutant ledger of package runtime (runtimefiles): edits of the core runtime packages that a runtime test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded by binsize BS1.

mutants.name: bs1-core-imports-crypto
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS1): runtime/v1 imports no crypto/, encoding/, hash/ or os/exec package; a body that needs one is in a leaf.

mutants.name: bs1-core-init
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS1): no core runtime package declares an init function.

mutants.name: bs8-core-imports-net
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS8): runtime/v1 imports no net/ package; the http and rpc bodies are in their leaves.

mutants.name: bs8-core-imports-log
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS8): runtime/v1 imports no log/ package; the redacted bodies, which format for slog, are in their leaf.

mutants.name: bs1-missing-import
mutants.rule: Files copies each package a leaf imports: the exec leaf imports runtime/rt.

mutants.name: bs2-core-imports-fmt
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): runtime/rt, runtime/rt/rttrace and runtime/v1 import no fmt, reflect or runtime/debug.

mutants.name: bs3-virtual-time
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS3): no type of package time is reachable from rt.Task through fields, elements and method signatures.

mutants.name: bs3-span-duration
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS3): a machine event, which a traced task's tracer reaches, holds its timer's In as an rt.Span.

mutants.name: bs3-walk-shallow
mutants.rule: The type-graph walk follows method signatures, as the Go linker does for a type used in an interface.
